title: Korean BBQ Beef
description: A flavorful and spicy Korean-style BBQ beef dish with a sweet and sticky marinade, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. Serve with steamed vegetables or rice for a well-rounded meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and Korean chili flakes.
Add the sliced beef to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Remove the beef from the marinade and grill for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the beef to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain.
In a small bowl, whisk together sesame oil and green onions. Brush the sauce onto the cooked beef during the last minute of grilling.
Serve the beef hot, garnished with additional green onions and sesame oil if desired.
